sloka: विविधान्यपि यानानि महान्ति च लघूनि च ।प्रययु: सुमहार्हाणि पादैरेव पदातय: ॥ २.९२.३४॥
transliteration: vividhānyapi yānāni mahānti ca laghūni ca ।prayayu: sumahārhāṇi pādaireva padātaya: ॥ 2.92.34॥

translations.english: Various types of costly carriages, large and small, set forth, while the infantry marched on.
